description:
SelectPdf can be used as a general purpose PDF library in any .NET application. It offers the possibility to create or modify existing documents, add new elements (like text, html, images, shapes), change pdf document security settings, merge or split existing documents and many more.

Select.Pdf also contains a state of the art html to pdf converter that supports the latest html and css versions.

This package contains the Chromium (CEF) rendering engine Windows binaries for SelectPdf Library for .NET Framework 2.0 and 4.0. Install alongside the Select.Pdf package to enable the Chromium (CEF) rendering engine for html to pdf conversions.
summary: Chromium (CEF) Windows binaries for SelectPdf Library for .NET Framework 2.0 / 4.0.
title: SelectPdf Library for .NET - Chromium (CEF) Binaries (Windows)
